name: Disabled Children
overview: Scripture affirms that every child, including those with disabilities, is fearfully and wonderfully made by God, who lovingly forms each person in the womb (Psalms 139:13-14). God’s presence brings strength and courage, promising never to forsake His people amid challenges (Deuteronomy 31:6). The prophetic vision in Isaiah points to a future restoration where disabilities will be healed, reflecting God's power to transform and bring hope (Isaiah 35:1,5). Additionally, God's plans for His children are for peace and a hopeful future, underscoring His sovereign care for all (Jeremiah 29:11).
